about: Runs of the deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) on this day (UTC, by the time GitHub queued them), oldest first, as GitHub's Actions API gave them. version: v<series>.<run number>, CI's own number. agent, what: from the commit the run built (the Agent: trailer). pushed: the head commit's time; queued: the run created; started: a runner took the job; queue_s between the last two. steps: seconds per step. jobs (from run 1618, three: build, deploy, tag): each job's queue_s, seconds and result; gap_s: build's end to deploy's start; superseded: build passed, deploy skipped (no longer dev's head). push_to_served_s: the run's own notice (it reads version.json on the live site until it serves this version). result: success, failure, cancelled (a newer push replaced it while it waited), in progress. tag: the version tag when it exists on that commit. Read by tools/ci-read.mjs.
